name: c-trace-22
title: Media transcode
description: Renditions that encode in parallel with their own percentages, then thumbnails and a CDN publish.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle, } from "@/components/ui/trace" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" const RENDITIONS = [ { label: "2160p HEVC", speed: 4, size: "1.4 GB" }, { label: "1080p H.264", speed: 7, size: "612 MB" }, { label: "720p H.264", speed: 11, size: "318 MB" }, ] const AFTER_ENCODE = ["thumbnails", "publish", "done"] as const type Stage = "encode" | (typeof AFTER_ENCODE)[number] const STATUS = ["pending", "running", undefined] as const const LABELS = { thumbnails: [ "Generate thumbnails", "Generating 24 thumbnails", "Generated 24 thumbnails", ], publish: [ "Publish to the CDN", "Publishing to the CDN", "Published to the CDN", ], } as const // Renditions encode in parallel under one row that stays open while any of // them runs. export function Pattern() { const [progress, setProgress] = React.useState(() => RENDITIONS.map(() => 0)) // Steps finished after encoding: 0 while thumbnails run, 2 when published. const [after, setAfter] = React.useState(0) const [encodeOpen, setEncodeOpen] = React.useState() // The stage is derived, never stored, so it cannot lag behind the numbers. const finished = progress.filter((p) => p >= 100).length const encoding = finished < RENDITIONS.length const stage: Stage = encoding ? "encode" : AFTER_ENCODE[after] React.useEffect(() => { if (stage === "done") return const timer = window.setTimeout( () => encoding ? setProgress((current) => current.map((p, i) => Math.min(100, p + RENDITIONS[i].speed)) ) : setAfter((n) => n + 1), encoding ? 160 : 1200 ) return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, [stage, encoding, progress]) // 0 pending, 1 running, 2 done: the index into that step's LABELS. const stepState = (step: keyof typeof LABELS) => { const index = AFTER_ENCODE.indexOf(step) if (encoding || after < index) return 0 return after === index ? 1 : 2 } return (
Uploaded launch-keynote.mov 1.8 GB {encoding ? `Encoding ${RENDITIONS.length} renditions` : `Encoded ${RENDITIONS.length} renditions`} {finished} of {RENDITIONS.length} {RENDITIONS.map((rendition, index) => { const done = progress[index] >= 100 return ( {done ? "Encoded" : "Encoding"} {rendition.label} {/* Percentages tick several times a second, so they are hidden from screen readers; the done line is not. */} {done ? rendition.size : `${progress[index]}%`} ) })} {LABELS.thumbnails[stepState("thumbnails")]} {LABELS.publish[stepState("publish")]}

{stage === "done" ? "Video ready, 4 renditions published" : ""}

) }
